name: ssi-learning-app
description: SSi Language Learning Application - Framework-agnostic core with UI adapters

scripts.test:invariants: vitest run -c vitest.api.config.ts --maxWorkers=2 api/_utils/definerSearchPath.security.test.ts api/_utils/securityTestMachineryIntegrity.security.test.ts api/_utils/adminPracticeMinutesAnonExposure.security.test.ts api/_utils/practiceMinutesSource.test.ts api/_security/sec0901-a-remediation-verification.security.test.ts api/_security/sec0901-x-audit-machinery.security.test.ts api/_security/sec0905-a-authflow.security.test.ts api/_security/support-inbox-view-no-auth-users.security.test.ts api/billing/bindingLadder.security.test.ts && pnpm --filter player-vue test:invariants
scripts.test:changed: vitest run -c vitest.api.config.ts --maxWorkers=2 --passWithNoTests --changed ${PREMERGE_BASE:-origin/dev} && pnpm --filter player-vue test:changed
scripts.test:premerge: pnpm test:invariants && pnpm test:changed && pnpm test:core
